contribution.position: I hold my earlier position. The QA turn cites peak_memory of 380MB, but artifact:perf-report records 740MB at peak load against a 512MB budget, about 45% over. That conflict needs to be resolved first, and the artifact as written supports the higher figure. At 740MB, OOM kills under load are likely, and the incident log shows retry storms caused both sev2 incidents last quarter. The cost and runbook findings are fine on their own axes, but they don't address this failure mode. Rollback steps shorten recovery and do not prevent the incident. Passing tests (412 passed, 87% coverage) say nothing about behavior at peak load. Evidence that would change my view: a load test at the production memory limit with no OOM kills, confirmation of retry backoff or caps, or a revised memory budget with a corrected perf measurement.
